projects.title: NTDP Intelligence Products
projects.brief: A governed Power BI platform connecting data, business questions, and executive reporting.
projects.audience: Business leaders, program teams, and analytics practitioners.
projects.role: Platform architecture, requirements, analytics delivery, and governance.
insights: Connect requirements to KPIs and analytical outputs so reports answer a defined business need.
Treat data quality and role-based access as part of the platform, alongside its visual design.
Combine automated refresh and reporting with controlled distribution to support recurring decisions.
projects.body:
I designed and implemented an integrated Power BI platform with data pipelines, semantic models, reporting, and statistical forecasting using DAX. My responsibilities span business requirements, maintenance, performance, security, and delivery.

The platform includes data quality dashboards and controls, role-based access through RLS and DAX authorization, and automated executive reporting with Power BI Report Builder.
projects.outcome: Launched the platform and introduced automated reporting, controlled access, and data quality monitoring.
projects.note: Professional overview. Internal reports and program data are not published here.

projects.title: Project Planning Integration
projects.brief: From vendor submissions to a centralized view of project schedules and progress.
projects.audience: PMO teams, project managers, and vendor coordinators.
projects.role: Planning template design, data consolidation, and timeline visualization.
insights: Standardized submissions make project information easier to combine and compare.
A shared timeline helps teams understand progress and coordinate delivery.
Design the input process for vendors as carefully as the final dashboard.
projects.body: I developed a vendor-friendly planning template and merged submissions into a centralized database with Power BI visualization. The work included a Gantt-based timeline to improve project and vendor tracking.
projects.outcome: Created an integrated planning approach connecting vendor submissions and project reporting.
projects.note: Professional overview. Project schedules and vendor information are not included.
